sources.role: pinned Waydroid source; configuration, image, Android-property and container paths
official Waydroid Linux installation and CLI documentation

paths.naming: INI file with [waydroid] initialization keys such as arch, images_path, vendor_type and [properties] Android-property overrides

paths.path: Runtime Android input devices inside the Waydroid container/session; no host-side profile file is defined by Waydroid
paths.naming: Waydroid starts/stops a Linux container and Android session; app/controller semantics belong to Android and the compositor/frontend rather than a Waydroid physical-device profile

paths.path: /var/lib/waydroid/data plus the per-user XDG data path ~/.local/share/waydroid/data
paths.naming: Android app/user data is container- and app-owned; no universal Waydroid game-save sidecar naming convention
Waydroid exposes container/session lifecycle controls, not emulator save-state slots
evidence: source:tools/helpers/arguments.py session/container actions contain no save-state action @5a51271131bfca8b7ee75ed067d09b26460f3a7b

paths.path: /var/lib/waydroid/images (or --images_path override), containing system.img/vendor.img and Android image assets
paths.naming: Android system/vendor images are installation/runtime assets, not a console BIOS; OTA/image provenance is channel- and device-specific
No external cryptographic key file is consumed by the Waydroid host tool contract
evidence: source:Waydroid configuration and container tool tree @5a51271131bfca8b7ee75ed067d09b26460f3a7b

linux.notes: Waydroid is a Linux container for Android (the upstream project documents LineageOS-based Android), not a console emulator.

linux-flatpak.reason: The pinned upstream source and official documentation provide Linux packages/configuration but no Waydroid Flatpak manifest or sandbox persistence contract.

windows.reason: Waydroid's source and official docs target a Linux container/session host; no native Windows host target is published.

macos.reason: Waydroid's source and official docs target a Linux container/session host; no native macOS host target is published.

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Waydroid controller profile writer: Android app input and compositor/container forwarding are runtime- and frontend-owned, while waydroid.cfg configures images and properties rather than physical controller bindings.

notes: Runtime container launch and effective Android gamepad input were not verified. Waydroid's image and property files are not a portable game-emulator persistence contract.
